description: Registry of skills the harness can vendor into workspaces. Reference skills by name in a template spec's `skills:` list. By default, paths resolve inside the hedera-dev/hedera-skills git repo (see `defaults`). Override with absolute or ./ relative `path` values for local development, or set per-skill `repo` / `ref`.

skills.name: project-scaffolding
skills.description: Scaffold CLAUDE.md and .claude/ project structure for AI-assisted workflows.

skills.name: quality-gates
skills.description: Linting, post-edit checks, deploy checklists, and CI quality gates.

skills.name: session-management
skills.description: Session continuity, work tracking, and report registry patterns.

skills.name: hedera-consensus-service
skills.description: Hedera Consensus Service patterns for topic creation, message submission, and mirror reads.

skills.name: hedera-token-service
skills.description: Hedera Token Service patterns for creating, managing, and transferring tokens.

skills.name: hts-system-contract

skills.name: hss-system-contract
skills.description: HSS system contract (0x16b) patterns: scheduleCall, capacity checks, deleteSchedule, and recurring vault reschedule loops in Solidity.

skills.name: hedera-oracle-adapters
